title: Beginners' Marathon Walk Schedule
author: Victor G.
desc:
This is a verbatim transcription of the free program posted by the World Class Racewalking org.

You can access the INSTRUCTIONS, TERMINOLOGY, and PDFs here: https://racewalking.org/walking-marathons.html

DO NOT do this program if you never ran/walked seriously before, try doing a 5k, 10k, or a half marathon first.
